title: one wide orders table with the address in every row, and the same data split so the address lives once

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders_wide (
  order_id   int  NOT NULL,
  sku        text NOT NULL,
  qty        int  NOT NULL,
  product    text NOT NULL,
  list_price numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  ordered_on date NOT NULL,
  email      text NOT NULL,
  customer   text NOT NULL,
  address    text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, sku)
);

steps.note: the wide table: one row per order line, the customer's name and address copied into every one.

steps.sql: SELECT order_id, sku, product, customer, address FROM orders_wide ORDER BY order_id, sku

steps.note: the split: customers get a row each, order lines point at them by id.

steps.sql: SELECT id, name, address FROM customers ORDER BY id
SELECT order_id, sku, customer_id FROM order_lines ORDER BY order_id, sku
steps.note: the order lines, each pointing at a customer.
